name: nRF Command Line Tools + J-Link
description: Installs nrfjprog (nRF Command Line Tools) and J-Link (from the official SEGGER .tgz archive) required for west flash/debug on nRF52/nRF53/nRF91 targets. Headless – no Qt/X11 required.

nrfCliVersion.description: Version of nRF Command Line Tools to install (e.g. 10.24.2)

version.description: Version of J-Link to install (e.g. V796a). See https://www.segger.com/downloads/jlink/ for available versions.

acceptSeggerEula.description: You must read and accept the SEGGER J-Link EULA at https://www.segger.com/downloads/jlink/ before setting this to true. Installation is aborted if this is false.
